props.label: Sec
props.html:
Painters across Waverley

Painting a coastal home is a different job to painting an inland one

Waverley sits right on the Tasman Sea. That view comes at a cost for your paintwork. Salt in the air, hard UV, ocean wind and quick weather swings all pull at exterior coatings, and a cheap repaint on a Bondi or Dover Heights facade can start lifting within a couple of summers. We plan for that from the first visit.

Sydney Paintmasters has been painting Eastern Suburbs homes for more than 20 years. We know how the streets near the water behave, where the render cracks, which timber details on the older places need real preparation, and how to keep a strata job moving without upsetting the residents. Every job runs off proper prep, the right system for the surface, and a fixed price agreed before we lift a brush.

This page covers the whole Waverley council area. Bondi and Bronte each have their own detailed page (linked below), and the smaller pockets like Tamarama, Queens Park and North Bondi are covered further down. Wherever you are in the LGA, you get the same licensed crew and the same standard of finish.

No call-out fee. No vague "from" pricing. Just a clear quote, a start date, and a tidy site when we leave.

props.label: Process
props.html:
How we work

Our 5-step painting process in Waverley

Simple, predictable, and built so you always know what happens next. No mystery, no moving goalposts.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit your Waverley property, look at the surfaces, talk through colours, and give you a written fixed price. No call-out fee.

2

Plan and prep

We lock a start date, protect your floors and gardens, and do the prep properly: washing, sanding, filling, and priming where needed.

3

Surface repair

Cracked render, flaking timber, rusted fixings and salt damage get sorted before any topcoat goes on. This is where coastal jobs are won.

4

Paint and coat

We apply the right system for each surface, usually two coats, cutting in neatly and keeping a clean, quiet site throughout.

5

Walk-through

We check the work with you, touch up anything you flag, clean up fully, and only call it done when you are happy.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What we are known for

Three things Waverley homes really need

Most painters can roll a wall. These are the areas where an Eastern Suburbs property needs someone who has done it before.

01

Coastal exterior painting

Homes in Bondi, Bronte, Tamarama and Dover Heights cop salt air, strong sun and ocean wind all year. We use thorough prep, corrosion protection on metal, and flexible exterior systems made to hold up near the water. That means a finish that still looks right after a few hard summers, not one that blisters by the next.

02

Heritage-sensitive work

Waverley is full of Victorian terraces, Federation homes and early twentieth-century cottages, many inside heritage conservation areas. Decorative timberwork, verandahs, rendered facades and period detailing need patient preparation and a careful hand. We treat these homes with the respect they are worth, and we flag where a colour scheme may need council approval.

03

Strata and apartments

Bondi Junction, Bondi and the wider LGA are dense with apartments, terraces and strata blocks. We paint common areas, facades, stairwells and occupied units with minimal disruption, clear scheduling and tidy access. We are comfortable working with owners corporations, building managers and busy residents.

Painters in Bondi Junction

Bondi Junction is the retail heart of the Eastern Suburbs, ringed by apartment towers around Westfield and the transport interchange. Most of our work here is strata and high-density: common areas, stairwells, facades and body-corporate repaints, plus commercial and retail fit-outs between tenancies. We schedule around residents and trading hours, and we keep occupied buildings clean and accessible while we work.

Get a Bondi Junction quote →
Coastal exposure

Painters in Bondi Beach

Bondi Beach sits right on the sand, so its apartments and inter-war blocks take the full force of salt-laden air. Exterior coatings here have to be chosen for that exposure, and balconies, render and window frames need real preparation before recoating. We use systems built to shrug off salt and sun, and we tidy every site daily. It is a tight, busy pocket, so access and timing matter as much as the paint.

Get a Bondi Beach quote →
Coastal family homes

Painters in North Bondi

North Bondi runs from the beach up to the headland, a mix of family homes, weatherboard cottages and apartments. Weatherboard and rendered exteriors up here weather fast in the wind and sun, so prep and the right primer make all the difference. Inside, we handle family-home refreshes with low-odour paints and quick, tidy turnarounds. Whether it is a whole house or one tired room, we treat it the same way.

Get a North Bondi quote →
Clifftop and exposed

Painters in Dover Heights

Dover Heights sits high on the cliffs, which means larger detached homes and some of the strongest wind and salt exposure in the LGA. Exteriors here need durable systems and proper render coatings to stay put. We prep hard, protect the metalwork, and pick finishes that cope with the weather up on the ridge. It is quieter than the beach suburbs, but the coastal wear is just as real.

Get a Dover Heights quote →
Parkside and period

Painters in Queens Park

Queens Park is a tightly held pocket beside Centennial Parklands, full of Victorian and Federation homes on leafy streets. These are period properties owned by people who care about getting the detail right, so heritage-sympathetic colours and careful preparation of timber and render are the norm. We do high-end interiors here too. Quiet, neat, and finished to a standard that suits the street.

Get a Queens Park quote →
Prestige clifftop

Painters in Tamarama

Tamarama, or Glamarama to the locals, is a small prestige pocket wedged between Bondi and Bronte. The homes here are high-end and often perched right above the water, so exteriors need premium, salt-resistant finishes and a discreet, careful crew. We handle these jobs quietly and thoroughly, inside and out.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Waverley painting FAQs

Pricing, process and timing, answered

The questions Waverley homeowners and building managers actually ask us.

How much does a painter cost in Waverley?
It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces and the prep involved, so we do not publish a flat rate that would only mislead you. What we do give is a free, fixed-price quote after seeing the property, with no call-out fee. You will know the full price before we start, and it will not move unless you change the scope. Call 0423 019 087 for a quote.
Do you charge a call-out fee for quotes?
No. Quotes across Waverley and the Eastern Suburbs are free and come with no call-out fee. We visit, assess the job, and give you a written fixed price with no obligation to go ahead.
How long does it take to paint a house in Waverley?
A single interior room can be a day. A full interior repaint of an average home usually runs a few days, and a full exterior depends on size, access and how much prep the surfaces need. Coastal exteriors often need extra preparation time, which we build into the quote. We give you a realistic timeline up front, not a hopeful one.
Do you provide a free quote?
Yes, every quote is free and fixed-price. Book one online through the form above or call 0423 019 087. We reply within one business day.
When can you start?
It depends on our current bookings and the size of your job, but we will give you a firm start date with your quote. We work 6am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday, which gives us flexibility to fit jobs in sooner rather than later.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. You are dealing with a licensed local business, not an unlicensed operator, and we are happy to confirm our details before you book.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Waverley?
Yes, and it is a big part of what we do. Waverley has many Victorian and Federation homes, some inside heritage conservation areas. We prepare decorative timber, verandahs and rendered facades carefully, and we will flag if a colour scheme may need council approval before you commit to it.
Can you paint strata and apartment buildings?
Yes. We paint common areas, facades, stairwells and occupied units, and we work well with owners corporations and building managers. Bondi Junction, Bondi and the wider LGA have plenty of strata, and we keep those jobs organised and low-disruption for residents.
Do you do exterior painting for coastal homes?
This is our home ground. Homes near the water in Bondi, Bronte, Tamarama and Dover Heights need thorough prep, corrosion protection on metal, and flexible coating systems made for salt and UV. We choose finishes that hold up in coastal conditions, so the job lasts.
What paint brands do you use?
We use quality, trade-grade paints matched to each surface and to the exposure it faces. For a coastal exterior we will spec a different system than for an internal wall. We are happy to talk through the options and product choices with you at the quote stage.
Do you paint occupied homes and offices?
Yes. We work in and around people all the time. For offices and commercial sites we can paint after hours or on weekends to avoid disruption, and for lived-in homes we keep the site clean, protect your things, and work room by room.
Do you offer a workmanship guarantee?
We stand behind our work and will come back to sort anything that is not right. For the exact terms of any written guarantee, ask us at the quote stage.
What areas of Waverley do you cover?
All of it. We paint in Bondi, Bondi Beach, Bondi Junction, Bronte, Dover Heights, North Bondi, Queens Park, Tamarama and Waverley, plus the surrounding Eastern Suburbs. If you are just outside the LGA, ask us anyway.
How should I prepare for the painters?
Not much is needed. Clear small items off the walls and shelves if you can, and let us know about pets, parking and access. We handle the rest, from moving and covering furniture to protecting floors and gardens before any paint goes on.

Painting a coastal home is a different job to painting an inland one

Waverley sits right on the Tasman Sea. That view comes at a cost for your paintwork. Salt in the air, hard UV, ocean wind and quick weather swings all pull at exterior coatings, and a cheap repaint on a Bondi or Dover Heights facade can start lifting within a couple of summers. We plan for that from the first visit.

Sydney Paintmasters has been painting Eastern Suburbs homes for more than 20 years. We know how the streets near the water behave, where the render cracks, which timber details on the older places need real preparation, and how to keep a strata job moving without upsetting the residents. Every job runs off proper prep, the right system for the surface, and a fixed price agreed before we lift a brush.

This page covers the whole Waverley council area. Bondi and Bronte each have their own detailed page (linked below), and the smaller pockets like Tamarama, Queens Park and North Bondi are covered further down. props.label: Process
props.html:
How we work

Our 5-step painting process in Waverley

Simple, predictable, and built so you always know what happens next. No mystery, no moving goalposts.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit your Waverley property, look at the surfaces, talk through colours, and give you a written fixed price. No call-out fee.

2

Plan and prep

We lock a start date, protect your floors and gardens, and do the prep properly: washing, sanding, filling, and priming where needed.

3

Surface repair

Cracked render, flaking timber, rusted fixings and salt damage get sorted before any topcoat goes on. This is where coastal jobs are won.

4

Paint and coat

We apply the right system for each surface, usually two coats, cutting in neatly and keeping a clean, quiet site throughout.

5

Walk-through

We check the work with you, touch up anything you flag, clean up fully, and only call it done when you are happy.

What we are known for

Three things Waverley homes really need

Most painters can roll a wall. These are the areas where an Eastern Suburbs property needs someone who has done it before.

Coastal exterior painting

Homes in Bondi, Bronte, Tamarama and Dover Heights cop salt air, strong sun and ocean wind all year. We use thorough prep, corrosion protection on metal, and flexible exterior systems made to hold up near the water. That means a finish that still looks right after a few hard summers, not one that blisters by the next.

Waverley is full of Victorian terraces, Federation homes and early twentieth-century cottages, many inside heritage conservation areas. Decorative timberwork, verandahs, rendered facades and period detailing need patient preparation and a careful hand. We treat these homes with the respect they are worth, and we flag where a colour scheme may need council approval.

Strata and apartments

Bondi Junction, Bondi and the wider LGA are dense with apartments, terraces and strata blocks. We paint common areas, facades, stairwells and occupied units with minimal disruption, clear scheduling and tidy access. We are comfortable working with owners corporations, building managers and busy residents.

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed local painting business serving Waverley 2024 and the Eastern Suburbs for 20+ years. Interior, exterior, strata, commercial, roof and coastal painting, with free fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across Waverley and the Eastern Suburbs for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Waverley?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces and the prep involved, so we do not publish a flat rate that would only mislead you. What we do give is a free, fixed-price quote after seeing the property, with no call-out fee. You will know the full price before we start, and it will not move unless you change the scope. Call 0423 019 087 for a quote.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee for quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quotes across Waverley and the Eastern Suburbs are free and come with no call-out fee. We visit, assess the job, and give you a written fixed price with no obligation to go ahead.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house in Waverley?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single interior room can be a day. A full interior repaint of an average home usually runs a few days, and a full exterior depends on size, access and how much prep the surfaces need. Coastal exteriors often need extra preparation time, which we build into the quote. We give you a realistic timeline up front, not a hopeful one.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide a free quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, every quote is free and fixed-price. Book one online through the form above or call 0423 019 087. We reply within one business day.

mainEntity.name: When can you start?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on our current bookings and the size of your job, but we will give you a firm start date with your quote. We work 6am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday, which gives us flexibility to fit jobs in sooner rather than later.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. You are dealing with a licensed local business, not an unlicensed operator, and we are happy to confirm our details before you book.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Waverley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and it is a big part of what we do. Waverley has many Victorian and Federation homes, some inside heritage conservation areas. We prepare decorative timber, verandahs and rendered facades carefully, and we will flag if a colour scheme may need council approval before you commit to it.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint strata and apartment buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We paint common areas, facades, stairwells and occupied units, and we work well with owners corporations and building managers. Bondi Junction, Bondi and the wider LGA have plenty of strata, and we keep those jobs organised and low-disruption for residents.

mainEntity.name: Do you do exterior painting for coastal homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is our home ground. Homes near the water in Bondi, Bronte, Tamarama and Dover Heights need thorough prep, corrosion protection on metal, and flexible coating systems made for salt and UV. We choose finishes that hold up in coastal conditions, so the job lasts.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use quality, trade-grade paints matched to each surface and to the exposure it faces. For a coastal exterior we will spec a different system than for an internal wall. We are happy to talk through the options and product choices with you at the quote stage.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint occupied homes and offices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work in and around people all the time. For offices and commercial sites we can paint after hours or on weekends to avoid disruption, and for lived-in homes we keep the site clean, protect your things, and work room by room.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a workmanship guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our work and will come back to sort anything that is not right. For the exact terms of any written guarantee, ask us at the quote stage.

mainEntity.name: What areas of Waverley do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of it. We paint in Bondi, Bondi Beach, Bondi Junction, Bronte, Dover Heights, North Bondi, Queens Park, Tamarama and Waverley, plus the surrounding Eastern Suburbs. If you are just outside the LGA, ask us anyway.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for the painters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not much is needed. Clear small items off the walls and shelves if you can, and let us know about pets, parking and access. We handle the rest, from moving and covering furniture to protecting floors and gardens before any paint goes on.
